weights.name: CLIP ViT-B-32 (openai)
weights.license: MIT (OpenAI CLIP), WebImageText-400M-trained; frame/state image encoder

abstention.method: max-prob threshold on temperature-scaled probs; per outer fold, chosen on inner leave-one-fold-out OOF for selective risk <= 0.2

run.notes: frozen features on GT track crops: CLIP ViT-B/32 start/end state embeddings + prompt sims, YOLO11n-pose keypoint stats, R(2+1)D-18 clip embeddings; L2 logistic regression; feature set ['state+pose', 'state+pose+motion'], C [0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03] and time-reversal augmentation weight [0.0, 0.5] (reversed segment labelled as pair partner) chosen per outer fold by inner-OOF NLL; per-fold: [('state+pose', 0.5, 0.01), ('state+pose', 0.5, 0.01), ('state+pose', 0.5, 0.01), ('state+pose', 0.0, 0.01), ('state+pose', 0.5, 0.01)]
